verdict.rationale: Booking the audit through a vendor-provided auditor network or in-house audit arm is a fair question for a compliance-automation platform, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows audit-readiness tooling and policy templates written by former auditors, which are adjacent features. Nothing documents an auditor marketplace, a booking flow, or published audit timelines.

support.subject: As a founder, I can book the audit itself through the vendor — a vetted auditor network or in-house audit arm with published expectations on timeline
